idea-plugin.name: AutoTranslate Strings V2
idea-plugin.description:
AutoTranslate Strings V2 for Android Studio and IntelliJ IDEA.

  • Automatically detects Android locale folders under res/values-*.
  • No hard-coded target-language list.
  • Translates only missing strings or refreshes all strings.
  • Protects Android format placeholders.
  • Skips resources marked translatable="false".

action.description: Translate Android strings into automatically detected locale folders
